name: McKenna Metal
old_description: We embrace challenges and adapt to timelines, budgets, and project revisions better than any shop in the industry. Our staff is equipped with decades of experience in metal fabrication.
about:
McKenna Metal, LLC was founded in 1995 in Portland, Oregon. The company operates a 30,000-square-foot facility in the city’s industrial northwest district. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication services including sheet metal and rotary tube laser cutting, waterjet cutting, welding (TIG, MIG, arc), metal forming via 240-ton and 55-ton press brakes, powder coating, and architectural metalwork. It runs an Amada Gemini CNC laser system with a 60-by-120-inch shuttle table and a rotary index laser for tube profiles up to 8.66 inches round. A 5-by-10-foot waterjet cuts metal, wood, acrylic, glass, stone, and tile. The powder coating booth measures 9 by 11 by 20 feet. The staff of over 40 includes CAD designers and welding technicians, and the company accepts AutoCAD and SolidWorks files.

McKenna Metal serves businesses and organizations throughout the Portland metro area—including Tualatin, Beaverton, Hillsboro, and Vancouver, Washington—and offers national shipping for out-of-state orders. Its project portfolio spans commercial, architectural, and decorative work, and the company also sells a line of retail metal goods such as garden labels, metal roses, and DIY kits through its online store.

The company emphasizes adaptability to changing timelines, budgets, and design revisions, and highlights its certified welding capabilities and quick turnaround times as key differentiators.
